vars.label: Social vulnerability, overall (CDC/ATSDR SVI rank, 0 to 1)
vars.ref: CDC/ATSDR Social Vulnerability Index 2022, Puerto Rico (American Community Survey 2018-2022)
vars.definition: CDC's overall rank, from the four themes together: socioeconomic status, household characteristics, racial and ethnic minority status, and housing type and transportation (16 survey measures). A rank of 0 is the least vulnerable municipio and 1 the most vulnerable, among the 78 municipios of Puerto Rico only: it cannot be compared with a state's.

vars.label: Social vulnerability: socioeconomic status (SVI theme 1, 0 to 1)
vars.ref: CDC/ATSDR Social Vulnerability Index 2022, Puerto Rico (American Community Survey 2018-2022)
vars.definition: The rank for theme 1: people below 150% of the poverty level, unemployed, with housing costs of 30% or more of income, without a high school diploma, and without health insurance. A rank of 0 is the least vulnerable municipio and 1 the most vulnerable, among the 78 municipios of Puerto Rico only: it cannot be compared with a state's.

vars.label: Social vulnerability: household characteristics (SVI theme 2, 0 to 1)
vars.ref: CDC/ATSDR Social Vulnerability Index 2022, Puerto Rico (American Community Survey 2018-2022)
vars.definition: The rank for theme 2: people 65 and older, 17 and younger, with a disability, single-parent households, and people who speak English less than well. A rank of 0 is the least vulnerable municipio and 1 the most vulnerable, among the 78 municipios of Puerto Rico only: it cannot be compared with a state's.

vars.label: Social vulnerability: housing type and transportation (SVI theme 4, 0 to 1)
vars.ref: CDC/ATSDR Social Vulnerability Index 2022, Puerto Rico (American Community Survey 2018-2022)
vars.definition: The rank for theme 4: homes in buildings of 10 or more units, mobile homes, crowded homes, households with no vehicle, and people in group quarters. A rank of 0 is the least vulnerable municipio and 1 the most vulnerable, among the 78 municipios of Puerto Rico only: it cannot be compared with a state's.

cdc_svi.name: CDC/ATSDR Social Vulnerability Index 2022
cdc_svi.license: US federal government data; CDC asks for its suggested citation
cdc_svi.note: Percentile ranks from the American Community Survey 2018-2022; Puerto Rico is ranked apart from the states.

notes.ranked_within: Puerto Rico only: municipios among the 78 municipios, tracts among Puerto Rico's tracts
notes.no_value: CDC's code -999 is null: a tract with no residents or too little data
notes.theme_3: Racial and ethnic minority status is not published as a dataset: its largest rank among Puerto Rico's tracts is 0.5223, because in 897 of the 922 tracts with a value 95% or more of the residents are a minority by the national definition. It is inside the overall rank, as CDC computes it.
notes.corrected: CDC says files downloaded between 2022-10-27 and 2026-01-15 were incorrect; these were downloaded after that
